description: Invoke a local tool (kind=tool) found with search_tools using its input schema. Entries with kind=mcp_server or mcp_tool return guidance for the direct provider connection. Call indexed tools by their original toolName on that server after checking its current tools/list. A care_service entry has no MCP server and returns its website for the patient to use directly. Entries with kind=local_resource return repository and usage guidance; they cannot run through this server. Check tool annotations before execution; some tools can change or share data.

arguments.description: Arguments for the entry, matching the inputSchema search_tools returned for it. An object, or a JSON string of one

name.description: Exact entry name returned by search_tools, for example directory.search_endpoints

name: execute_tool
title: Execute a Flexpa capability
